text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Curious about the noisy commotion in the schoolyard, I took a peek—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Thank you all for your cooperation. Let us put our hearts into filming this family sitcom drama. Our goal is 1 million views on UmaTube.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: First, the distribution of scripts and announcement of roles. Playing Dad: Vodka. Playing Mom: Scarlet.

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: M-Married couple... with *this* idiot?! No, since I agreed to it, I'll do it right...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Eldest daughter: Machan.
Second daughter: Turbo-san.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Neighbor: McQueen-san.
And the company president: Teio-san.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
The president, huh... Yeah, yeah, that suits
someone like me perfectly! And filming sounds fun!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Fufufu. This will also serve as a record
of Machan and everyone being classmates.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Now then, let us begin right away.
"Once upon a time, there was a happily
married couple who got along wonderfully."

text_block_list.name: Dad
text_block_list.text:
"Mama is as cute as ever today..."
Wait, are you kidding me?!

text_block_list.name: Mom
text_block_list.text:
"Mama loves Papa so much, too..."
Like hell I do?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Papa and Mama got along wonderfully today as well.
And then—"

text_block_list.name: Neighbor
text_block_list.text:
Um, is it my turn now...? 
"Pardon me, I came to share some of our usual shiitake—"

text_block_list.name: Second Daughter
text_block_list.text:
Hey, hey, let's play a game! A game!
Teio, come join in too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wait, hold on... It's not my turn yet!
I'm not supposed to be on camera yet~~!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Ah, we're straying further and further from the script...
We can't even get to the part where
"I am treated to some miso soup" at all...?!

After that, the story went completely off the rails,
and the play descended into utter chaos—

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Next is the final scene. This is my absolute
favorite part... Please do your best, yes yes!

text_block_list.name: Mom
text_block_list.text:
"This dashi isn't the usual brand!
Can't you even go grocery shopping right?!"
You absolute idiot!!

text_block_list.name: Dad
text_block_list.text:
"I couldn't help it!
They were sold out of the usual one—"

text_block_list.name: Dad
text_block_list.text: Wait, what was that last ad-lib of yours just now?!

text_block_list.name: Eldest Daughter
text_block_list.text:
"Neither Papa nor Mama is at fault.
The usual dashi has simply been discontinued..."

text_block_list.name: Eldest Daughter
text_block_list.text:
"In order to bring back the dashi of our memories...
Machan is going on a journey.
Papa, Mama, please wait for me. Farewell."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Three thousand leagues in search of dashi...
The destination she finally arrived at was that very manufacturer!

text_block_list.name: President
text_block_list.text:
"Do you truly wish to revive that dashi so badly...?
Then prove its worth with your own power!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—For the sake of the dashi of memories, Machan's
battle as the new factory manager begins...!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: —Cut!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Hmmmm~~... This is...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
...I'm sorry, Machan!
Because we couldn't stick to the script, the story got totally...

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: It. Was. Per. Fect!

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
We managed to film the greatest drama.
Thank you, thank you, everyone.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
In order to restore happiness to the family,
dashi is absolutely essential... We captured that essence.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to you all, a wonderful story of love was filmed.
A heart-full story about taking back love.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
The guest over there must be deeply moved as well.
Right, Trainer-san?

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Please feel free to share your thoughts.
I will use them for thumbnail inspiration, so please, go ahead.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I was suddenly put on the spot.
Admittedly, its overly unique world had completely
drawn me in, but...
choice_data_list: Looks like it might go viral...?
Looks like it might go viral...?
The passion definitely came through, I think

text_block_list.text:
I was suddenly put on the spot.
Admittedly, its overly unique world had completely
drawn me in, but...
choice_data_list: Looks like it might go viral...?

The passion definitely came through, I think

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: You think so too, don't you? Heheh, smug.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
With this, Machan will be remembered even more
in everyone's hearts. Heartwarming warmth.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Passion.
The most important element in the "arts."
It seems Machan has nailed it down solid.

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text:
Shubibi. I have a hunch it will become immensely popular.
I must start preparing for the sequel right away...!
